question:
For all the set of cards that has Brazil Portuguese translation, what is the percentage of them are only available online?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Brazil Portuguese translation refers to language = 'Portuguese (Brazil)'; only available online refers to isOnlineOnly = 1; percentage of online only Brazil Portuguese in all Brazil Portuguese cards refers to DIVIDE(SUM(isOnlineOnly = 1), SUM(language = 'Portuguese (Brazil)))*100

  CAST(SUM(s.XCL_103) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*)
